0.0: Hella told me about #b#t4031056##k a while back. I was tracking it down, but I dropped my journal out on the Snowfield when I stumbled across this weird #bSmall Tomb#k. You think it might be in there?

yes.0: I wanted to find out what that tomb was, so I tried getting close to it, only to realize that it was impossible because of all the scary monsters around that area. You're strong enough, though, to find a way to go in there and thoroughly investigate the tomb. The tomb was at #bIcy Cold Field#k. I'll pray for your safety until you return...

npc.0: I found that weird #bSmall Tomb#k deep in the valley of the Snowfield. There were scary monsters crawling all over the place, so I had to run. Now I think I might have been in the right place. It was out in the #bIcy Cold Field#k. I bet the book is there!

quest.0: In the tomb there was some moss, a corpse, and not much else. Looked further in but still found nothing.
